products.title: Microsoft Surface Laptop (13", Snapdragon X Plus, 2025)
products.description: This is the 13-inch Microsoft Surface Laptop, a Copilot+ PC that is ultra-lightweight at just 2.7 pounds and offers up to 23 hours of battery life. It features a brilliant 13-inch PixelSense touchscreen display with a 1920 x 1280 resolution and a 60 Hz refresh rate. Powered by the Snapdragon X Plus (8 Core) processor and a turbocharged NPU with 45 trillion operations per second, it redefines speed and AI-enhanced performance. The laptop comes with 16GB of LPDDR5x RAM and 512GB of UFS storage, ensuring fast multitasking, app launches, and file transfers. It runs Windows 11 Home and integrates AI-powered tools like Recall, Cocreator, Restyle Image, and Click to Do for enhanced productivity and creativity. The device also features a 1080p Full HD front-facing camera with Windows Studio Effects, dual USB-C 3.2 ports, a USB-A 3.1 port, a 3.5mm jack, Wi-Fi 7, and Bluetooth 5.4. The keyboard is backlit, and security features include Microsoft Pluton TPM 2.0 and Windows 11 Secured-core PC.
